summary: Criterion C-7 (page at / shows 'N notes' where N is the store size) is met by the change. public/index.html no longer hardcodes a count; it fetches /api/notes and writes notes.length + ' notes'. src/server.mjs exports startServer(store, port) so the test can inject a store. npm test passes 6 of 6, including the new /api/notes and page test. The browser render of the inline script was not executed; C-7 is verified from the code path and the test's static HTML checks. The slice is recorded as S-4 as requested; plan.json lists the note-count work under S-3 and commit 86da41a is tagged [S-3], so the id mismatch is the caller's to reconcile.

findings.issue: The new test checks the page only statically (no hardcoded '0 notes' and the presence of '/api/notes'). It does not execute the inline script, so nothing in the suite confirms that the DOM text becomes 'N notes' after the fetch resolves. The C-7 behavior rests on reading the script in public/index.html.
findings.suggestion: Optionally add a DOM-level check (for example a jsdom or browser run) that the count element reads 'N notes' for a store of N notes.

findings.issue: The main-module block now seeds the store from LANTERN_SEED. This is a development convenience outside C-7. It does not change the page contract and only runs when the file is the entry point.
findings.suggestion: Consider noting LANTERN_SEED in the README, or dropping it if it is not needed for this slice.

evidence.quote: for (let i = 1; i <= Number(process.env.LANTERN_SEED ?? 0); i++) createNote(store, { title: `Sample ${i}` });

criteria.note: The page fetches /api/notes, which returns listNotes(store) for the injected store, and writes the length followed by ' notes'. The count is therefore the store size. The browser render was not run.
